name: Static DC field over left M1 (tSMS comparison)
origin: Project construct after transcranial static magnetic stimulation (tSMS; Oliviero, Foffani and colleagues, Toledo); replication failures by the Kammer group (Ulm)
summary: A constant current through one coil at C3, near the left motor cortex hand area, for 20 min, to show that a DC coil offset is not tSMS: at 20 mm its static field is 13,000 to 38,000 times weaker than a tSMS magnet's at 2 to 3 cm, and smaller than the Earth's field. Untested and not expected to do anything. Use it for education or as a control condition that looks active.
notes: In tSMS a strong NdFeB magnet is held over the motor cortex hand area, found as the TMS hot spot. Oliviero 2011 used a magnet of 45 x 30 mm and give no field in tesla (p.2 [4950]); they reported up to 25% smaller motor evoked potentials after at least 10 min. Kirimoto 2016 used a magnet of 50 x 30 mm with 512 mT measured at its surface, and 110 to 190 mT at 2 to 3 cm from the centre of that surface (p.3, p.5). This program puts a constant +A (at most 4.54 mA) through one coil at C3 for 20 min. Only the site and the duration follow tSMS. C3 is an approximation: Kirimoto places the hot spot 2 to 3 cm in front of C3 (p.5). For the right hand area put the coil at C4. The tSMS field is Kirimoto's 110 to 190 mT at 2 to 3 cm from the magnet. This program's setting is the peak field 20 mm in front of each coil. At 5 to 8.4 uT the coil's static field is 13,000 to 38,000 times weaker, and smaller than the Earth's static field (about 35 to 50 uT; about 35 uT in Wang 2019's lab). Turning your head in the Earth's field changes the local field more than this coil does. This program is untested and no effect is expected; it exists to make that point and to serve as an active-looking control. tSMS itself is contested: Lorenz 2026, a neuronavigated study from the Kammer group (Ulm), found no effect. It recruited 39 people, kept 37 and analysed 19 datasets per hemisphere, five people contributing both (p.2), and it cites two earlier studies of the group (Kufner 2017, Lorenz 2020). Dissipation is trivial (calculated: about 0.09 mW in the coil and 45 mW in the 2.2 kOhm series resistor).
setting: Seated, 10-20 min (Oliviero 2011: at least 10 min of tSMS was needed for an effect).
schedule: As the program it is compared with; no schedule applies to this field.
source: Oliviero et al. 2011, J Physiol https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/21807616/ ; Kirimoto et al. 2016, Sci Rep (110-190 mT at 2-3 cm) https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC5048290/ ; Lorenz et al. 2026 (neuronavigated tSMS replication, no effect) https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC12992518/ ; Wang et al. 2019, eNeuro (ambient lab field about 35 uT) https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC6494972/
